description: We are seeking a dedicated and experienced Licensed Nursing Home Administrator (LNHA) to lead a premier health and rehabilitation center in Baltimore County, MD. This confidential opportunity is ideal for a visionary leader passionate about delivering exceptional patient care and fostering a supportive environment for both residents and staff.As the LNHA, you will be responsible for the overall operational management of the facility, ensuring compliance with all state and federal regulations. You will play a critical role in maintaining high standards of quality care, optimizing financial performance, and cultivating a positive culture that promotes resident well-being and staff engagement. Join a team committed to excellence and make a significant impact on the lives of those we serve.
requirements: Active and unencumbered Licensed Nursing Home Administrator (LNHA) license in Maryland.
Proven experience as an LNHA in a skilled nursing or rehabilitation facility.
Comprehensive knowledge of state and federal healthcare regulations.
Strong leadership, financial management, and communication skills.
Commitment to quality patient care and operational excellence.
salaryOrBonusInfo: Compensation ranges from $115,000 to $145,000 per year, based on experience.
